text: 十余年经历多轮升贬值周期，央行系统阐述人民币汇率立场 全球经济失衡是产业分工格局演进等因素共同作用的结果，不是顺差国或逆差国单方面的责任。
text_en: Over a Decade Through Multiple Appreciation and Depreciation Cycles, PBOC Systematically Expounds RMB Exchange Rate Stance — Global economic imbalances are the result of factors including the evolution of industrial division of labor, not the unilateral responsibility of surplus or deficit countries.
